articles.abstract_en: We describe a sequential mechanism that fully implements the set of efficient outcomes in environments with quasi-linear utilities. The mechanism asks agents to take turns in defining prices for each outcome, with a final player choosing an outcome for all: Price and Choose. The choice triggers a sequence of payments from each agent to the preceding agent. We present several extensions. First, payoff inequalities may be reduced by endogenizing the order of play. Second, our results extend to a model without quasi-linear utility, to a setting with an outside option, robustness to max-min behavior, and caps on prices. (JEL C72, D11, D44, D71, D82)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们描述了一种序贯机制，该机制在拟线性效用环境中完全实现了有效结果的集合。该机制要求代理人轮流为每个结果定义价格，由最后一位玩家为所有人选择一个结果：定价与选择。这一选择触发一系列从每位代理人向前一位代理人支付的款项。我们提出了若干扩展。首先，通过内生决定行动顺序可以减少收益不平等。其次，我们的结果扩展到无拟线性效用的模型、具有外部选项的设置、对最大最小行为的稳健性以及价格上限。（JEL C72, D11, D44, D71, D82）

articles.title_cn: 激进转型与企业家技能
articles.abstract_en: We study pivots as signaling devices in a dynamic experimentation model. An entrepreneur receives funding from an investor and has private information about a project, which requires costly experimentation to succeed. The entrepreneur has a real option to pivot, i.e., to abandon the project and to start a new one. Investors learn about the project from the arrival of exogenous information and from the entrepreneur’s pivoting decisions. We characterize signaling equilibria in which high-skill entrepreneurs pivot early. Such early pivots are associated with higher likelihood of success and with more favorable funding terms following the pivot. (JEL D21, D82, L26, M13)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在一个动态实验模型中研究转型作为信号装置的作用。企业家从投资者处获得资金，并拥有关于项目的私人信息，该项目需要昂贵的实验才能成功。企业家拥有转型的真实期权，即放弃当前项目并启动新项目。投资者通过外生信息的到达以及企业家的转型决策来了解项目情况。我们刻画了高技能企业家早期转型的信号均衡。这种早期转型与更高的成功可能性以及转型后更有利的融资条件相关联。（JEL D21, D82, L26, M13）

articles.title_en: Complementary Bidding and the Collusive Arrangement: Evidence from an Antitrust Investigation
articles.title_cn: 互补性投标与共谋安排：来自一项反垄断调查的证据
articles.abstract_en: Clustered bids and a missing mass of nearly tied bids have both been proposed as markers of collusion. We present causal empirical evidence from an actual procurement cartel that bidding involves both clustering and a gap around the winning bid. We support these results with information from the testimony of cartel participants that explains how both patterns arise naturally as part of an arrangement featuring complementary bidding. Based on these findings, we develop an easy-to-implement screen for collusive arrangements featuring complementary bidding. (JEL D43, D44, H76, L12, L13, L74)
articles.abstract_cn: 聚集性投标和近乎并列投标的缺失质量均被提出作为共谋的标志。我们提供了来自实际采购卡特尔的经验证据，表明投标既包含聚集性，也包含围绕中标价的缺口。我们通过卡特尔参与者的证词信息支持这些结果，这些证词解释了这两种模式如何作为具有互补性投标特征的安排的一部分自然产生。基于这些发现，我们开发了一种易于实施的筛选方法，用于识别具有互补性投标特征的共谋安排。(JEL D43, D44, H76, L12, L13, L74)

articles.title_en: Optimal Contract Regulation in Selection Markets
articles.title_cn: 选择市场中的最优合同监管
articles.abstract_en: We model competitive insurance markets with continuous cost-types. A regulator sets minimum and maximum coverage levels and a fee for nonbuyers. Equilibrium is unique if the type distribution is log-concave. Increasing the nonpurchase fee increases welfare if the density of types is decreasing. The optimal level of the minimum coverage is positive, is below full insurance, and induces some pooling at the minimum coverage contract. The optimal level of the maximum coverage is full insurance, even in an extension that allows for ex post moral hazard. (JEL D82, D86, G22, G28)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们模拟了具有连续成本类型的竞争性保险市场。监管者设定最低和最高保障水平，并对非购买者收取费用。如果类型分布是对数凹的，则均衡是唯一的。如果类型的密度递减，增加非购买费用会提高福利。最低保障的最优水平为正，低于全额保险，并在最低保障合同处引发一些混合。最高保障的最优水平为全额保险，即使在允许事后道德风险的扩展中也是如此。(JEL D82, D86, G22, G28)

articles.abstract_en: Empirical search cost estimates are often large and increasing in the size of the transaction. We conduct an online search experiment in which we manipulate the price scale while keeping the physical search effort per price quote constant. Additionally, we obtain a direct measure of subjects’ opportunity costs of time. Using a standard search model, we confirm that search cost estimates are large and increasing in the price scale. We then modify the model to incorporate context effects with respect to prices. This results in search cost estimates that are scale independent and correspond well to subjects’ opportunity costs of time. (JEL C91, D12, D81, D83, D91)
articles.abstract_cn: 实证搜索成本估计通常较大，并随交易规模增加而增加。我们进行了一项在线搜索实验，在保持每次报价的物理搜索努力不变的情况下操纵价格尺度。此外，我们直接测量了受试者的时间机会成本。使用标准搜索模型，我们确认搜索成本估计较大且随价格尺度增加。然后，我们修改模型以纳入价格方面的情境效应。这导致搜索成本估计与尺度无关，并与受试者的时间机会成本良好对应。(JEL C91, D12, D81, D83, D91)

articles.title_en: Ideological Bias and Trust in Information Sources
articles.title_cn: 意识形态偏见与信息来源信任
articles.abstract_en: We study the role of endogenous trust in amplifying ideological bias. Agents in our model learn a sequence of states from sources whose accuracy is ex ante uncertain. Agents learn these accuracies by comparing their own reasoning about the states based on introspection or direct experience to the sources’ reports. Small biases in this reasoning can cause large ideological differences in the agents’ trust in information sources and their beliefs about the states, and may lead agents to become overconfident in their own reasoning. Disagreements can be similar in magnitude whether agents see only ideologically aligned sources or diverse sources. (JEL D42, D72, D83, L25, L82, Z13)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了内生信任在放大意识形态偏见中的作用。在我们的模型中，代理人从准确性事前不确定的来源学习一系列状态。代理人通过将自身基于内省或直接经验对状态的推理与来源的报告进行比较来学习这些准确性。这种推理中的微小偏见可能导致代理人对信息来源的信任及其对状态的信念产生巨大的意识形态差异，并可能使代理人对自己推理过度自信。无论代理人只接触意识形态一致的来源还是多样化的来源，分歧的程度可能相似。(JEL D42, D72, D83, L25, L82, Z13)

articles.title_en: Strategic Thinking Skills: A Key to Collective Economic Success
articles.title_cn: 战略思维能力：集体经济成功的关键
articles.abstract_en: We conduct a large-scale experiment to measure elementary aspects of strategic thinking skills and their linkage to labor market outcomes. Two incentivized measures of higher-order rationality and backward induction are developed. Males’ (females’) strategic thinking skills are positively (negatively) associated with individual labor income. However, among married individuals, strategic thinking skills are significantly and positively associated with their household labor income regardless of gender, highlighting the importance of strategic thinking skills for collective economic success. We argue that the intrahousehold channels encompassing collective labor supply with home-to-workplace spillover and marriage assortative matching offer the most plausible explanation for our findings. (JEL D91, J16, J22, J24, J31)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们进行了一项大规模实验，以衡量战略思维能力的基本方面及其与劳动力市场结果的关联。我们开发了两种激励性的高阶理性与逆向归纳度量。男性（女性）的战略思维能力与个人劳动收入呈正（负）相关。然而，在已婚个体中，无论性别如何，战略思维能力与其家庭劳动收入显著正相关，这凸显了战略思维能力对集体经济成功的重要性。我们认为，涵盖家庭集体劳动供给与家庭到工作场所溢出效应以及婚姻匹配选择的家庭内部渠道，为我们发现提供了最合理的解释。（JEL D91, J16, J22, J24, J31）

articles.title_en: Severance Pay in an Optimal Contract
articles.abstract_en: We study the incentive role of severance compensation. In a canonical principal-agent model, we introduce exogenous job destruction risk and show that compensation following job destruction can reduce overall incentive costs. To mitigate the risk of inefficient endogenous termination, agents with low continuation value receive no severance and lose value at job destruction, while agents with high continuation value receive high severance and gain value at job destruction. Comparative statics offer a novel explanation for the positive wage-tenure profile observed in the data: Average tenure and compensation should both be higher in jobs less exposed to job destruction risk. (JEL D82, D86, J31, J41, J64, J65)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究遣散补偿的激励作用。在一个经典的主代理模型中，我们引入外生的工作毁灭风险，并表明工作毁灭后的补偿可以降低总体激励成本。为了减轻低效内生终止的风险，具有低持续价值的代理人在工作毁灭时得不到遣散费并损失价值，而具有高持续价值的代理人则获得高遣散费并在工作毁灭时增加价值。比较静态分析为数据中观察到的正工资-任期关系提供了新的解释：平均任期和补偿在工作毁灭风险较低的职位上都应更高。(JEL D82, D86, J31, J41, J64, J65)

articles.title_en: Free Entry in a Cournot Market with Overlapping Ownership
articles.title_cn: 交叉持股的古诺市场中的自由进入
articles.abstract_en: We examine the effects of overlapping ownership among existing firms deciding whether to enter a product market. We show that in most cases—and especially when overlapping ownership is already widespread—an increase in the extent of overlapping ownership will harm welfare by softening product market competition, reducing entry, and thereby (in contrast to standard results) inducing insufficient entry and magnifying the negative impact of an increase of entry costs on entry. Overlapping ownership can mostly be beneficial only under substantial increasing returns to scale, in which case industry consolidation (induced by overlapping ownership) leads to sizable cost efficiencies. (JEL D21, D24, D43, G24, G34, K21, L13)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了在决定是否进入产品市场的现有企业之间交叉持股的影响。我们表明，在大多数情况下——尤其是当交叉持股已经普遍存在时——交叉持股程度的增加将通过软化产品市场竞争、减少进入，从而（与标准结果相反）导致进入不足，并放大进入成本增加对进入的负面影响，从而损害福利。交叉持股主要只有在显著的规模收益递增情况下才可能是有益的，在这种情况下，行业整合（由交叉持股引起）会带来可观的成本效率。（JEL D21, D24, D43, G24, G34, K21, L13）

articles.abstract_en: A continuum of citizens with heterogeneous opportunity costs participates in a protest with well-defined demands. As long as the government doesn’t concede, it pays a cost increasing in time and participation. Citizens who are part of the victory team enjoy a “veteran reward.” Every equilibrium with protest displays a buildup stage during which citizens join the protest but the government ignores them, a peak at which the government concedes with positive probability, and a decay stage in which the government concedes with some density and citizens continuously drop out. The set of equilibria is fully described by the peak time. (JEL D11, D72, D74)
articles.abstract_cn: 一个由具有异质性机会成本的连续统公民组成的群体参与一场诉求明确的抗议。只要政府不做出让步，它就会承担随时间与参与人数增加而增加的成本。参与胜利队伍的公民享有“老兵奖励”。每一个存在抗议的均衡都表现出一个积累阶段，在此期间公民加入抗议但政府忽视他们；一个高峰阶段，此时政府以正概率让步；以及一个衰退阶段，政府以一定密度让步，公民持续退出。均衡集合完全由高峰时间描述。(JEL D11, D72, D74)
